exposure: Mode of conception (spontaneous or medically assisted reproduction)
outcome: Apgar score less than 7 at 5 minutes
cohort: 2235 twin pregnancies (4470 neonates) delivered at more than 24 weeks of pregnancy at a single university teaching hospital between January 1995 and September 2019
finding: Neonatal condition of twin pregnancies at birth was similar between those conceived spontaneously and those conceived through medically assisted reproduction, including IVF and OI.
mod_finding: The primary outcomes were comparable between groups even after adjusting for mode of delivery, which differed between the groups.
